reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_rows drops the observed demand text: its source builds each selected record without the need field, and the assigned output then contains eight blank needs despite nonblank needs in the assigned input. That breaks exact handoff preservation and causes downstream coverage/recommendation to operate on empty demand claims.

normalize_evidence reindexes the selected rows to the required columns, fills missing values, retains the allowed record ids, and preserves the need column when supplied. The blank needs seen in the assigned output are explained by the upstream selected records lacking need values, not by this boundary independently erasing valid need text.

assemble_provenance deterministically sorts retained needs by demand_score descending and record_id, then emits ranked evidence_sources with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank. Its assigned output preserves the evidence handoff count and rank order. It does not handle need text, so it is not the source of the downstream empty top_need defect.
